narration.en: Many companies had perfect plans for 2020, and then the pandemic arrived. Planning is powerful, but it has limits.

body.en: Planning may create rigidity; it may not work in a dynamic environment; it may reduce creativity because people only carry out orders; it involves huge costs; it is time-consuming; and it does not guarantee success.

points.en: May not work in a dynamic environment

narration.en: Planning may create rigidity; it may not work in a dynamic environment; it may reduce creativity because people only carry out orders; it involves huge costs; it is time-consuming; and it does not guarantee success.
narration.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ಕಠಿಣತೆ ತರಬಹುದು, ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಪರಿಸರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡದಿರಬಹುದು, ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆ ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸಬಹುದು, ದುಬಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಖಾತರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Planning has six limitations. Let us list them as warning signs.
One: plans can create rigidity; managers stick to them even when they should change.
Two: in a dynamic environment, plans may quickly go out of date.
Three: it can reduce creativity, as people only follow orders.
Four and five: it involves huge costs and takes time.
Six: a plan alone does not guarantee success; implementation matters.
So keep plans flexible and review them often.

problem.en: A Ballari garment unit made a rigid five-year plan to export only to Europe. When European demand fell and Middle-East buyers asked for orders, the manager refused because "it is not in the plan". Which limitations of planning are seen?

steps.en: Refusing a good order because of the plan: planning creates rigidity.
European demand changed: planning may not work in a dynamic environment.
The plan did not bring success by itself: planning does not guarantee success.

answer.en: Rigidity, failure in a dynamic environment, and no guarantee of success.

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲು ಒಂದು ತಂಡ; ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಿ.

points.en: Planning can create rigidity and reduce creativity.
It may fail when the environment changes.
It is costly, time-consuming and does not guarantee success.
